projection.name: Songs for Self on the Every Noise at Once 2023 reference map
projection.method: Sourced primary and secondary labels are normalized and matched to the pinned 2023-12-04 Every Noise genre map. Multiple matches use their coordinate centroid. When a label is unsupported, a source-addressable current artist-membership bridge supplies real genre memberships whose coordinates still come from the pinned Every Noise map. The remaining unsupported tracks use the centroid of named Every Noise reference genres in their reviewed top-level family. A tiny deterministic display-only jitter separates overlapping songs; referenceX/referenceY retain the exact matched or centroid coordinate.
axes: Every Noise left-to-right reference coordinate; described by the original project as denser/more atmospheric to spikier/bouncier.
Every Noise top-to-bottom reference coordinate; described by the original project as more mechanical/electric to more organic.
